messages:
sara: Heads-up team: I'm proposing we tighten default retention for partner-facing SIEM snapshots to 21 days instead of current 90. Reason: reduce sensitive-data residency and cost. Need discussion on RBAC gating, KMS unwrap flow, and legal exceptions. @liam @anita
liam: 21d rationale? seems short for incident follow-up. Are we pairing this with an easy exception/extension flow?
anita: yes, 21d is OK as baseline for partner handbacks. We should require a documented extension checkbox that triggers manual ELA review. Also add a retention_reviewer field to the request so we have a clear approver audit trail.
sara: Proposed roles (names differ from current): `logs:export.requestor`, `logs:export.approver`, `logs:export.runner`. Only `runner` can call the KMS-unlock service. We should allow a small set of machine accounts for runner.
liam: For KMS: prefer a wrapped-unseal proxy pattern. Approver flips a flag in the request system. Runner service calls KMS:Decrypt with CMK and strict condition on EncryptionContext.request_id and subject. Decrypt token TTL = 10m. All decrypts emit CloudTrail + a dedicated SIEM "export.activity" event with request_id, approver, and executor.
anita: Also add a required `contains_sensitive` checkbox on the request; if true, DLP pipeline must run prior to export, and output written to a quarantined bucket until approved.
sara: Draft request form (please comment)
```
request_id: auto
requestor: name/email/org
scope: index patterns + time window
purpose: free text justification
baseline_retention_days: 21 (max 365 unless exception)
extension_reason: optional (required if >21)
retention_reviewer: security or legal (automatically assigned if extension)
contains_sensitive: checkbox
dlp_required: checkbox (auto set if contains_sensitive)
preferred_bucket: readonly suggestion
audit_links: links to ticket / slack thread
```
liam: Add `legal_hold_needed` boolean. If true, mark request immutable and route to legal. Under legal_hold, automated KMS unwrap is disabled; unwrapping must be executed by a named operator with two-person approval and recorded video (or appt) — we can specify required attestation in the workflow.
anita: On RBAC enforcement: we should ensure `logs:export.runner` can assume a short-lived service token only after request is approved. Use STS-style assume-role with ApprovalSession tag containing request_id and approver. That way we can audit token creation and deny if session tags don't match.
liam: Example CLI for request creation (for triage team):
```bash
# create request
redwood logs export request --scope "auth-logs:2026-03-05..2026-03-06" \\  --retention 21 --purpose "partner malware triage" --requestor sara@redwood.ai
# check status
redwood logs export status --id REQ-2026-0422-07
```
ops-bot: ticket created: SEC-EX-2026-0422 9;partner-handback-retention9; status: open. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-EX-2026-0422
sara: KMS policy notes (short): require EncryptionContext.request_id, require request_approved=true tag in request system (enforce via conditions on CMK), deny Decrypt for requests flagged legal_hold, log events to CloudTrail with kms:RequestId mapping. Also rotate CMK annually and ensure key version used is recorded in export.audit metadata.
liam: We also need lifecycle policy per bucket: add S3 lifecycle rule: transition non-sensitive exports to IA at 7d, delete at retention_days. Sensitive exports stay in quarantined path and require manual GC by security after approval.
anita: UX: make default retention slider prefilled at 21 with inline tooltip: "default protects partner data; request extension for investigations". Add required radio for data categories (PII, Auth, Payment) so DLP rules auto-enable.
sara: Action items: 1) liam - draft KMS proxy + CMK condition snippet and CloudTrail mapping 2) anita - PR for request schema + UI changes (contains_sensitive, legal_hold flag) 3) sara - open RBAC PR for `logs:export.*` roles and machine account allowlist 4) ops-bot - create ticket watchers for legal & sec on extensions. Sync in tomorrow's security sync at 10:30am.
compliance-bot: Reminder: please attach retention-justification template and redact examples before public docs.
liam: I'll start the KMS policy and a sample CloudTrail query for decrypt events. Expect draft by EOD.
anita: I'll prototype the request form and DLP gating flags.
sara: Thanks all. Will post a short RFC before EOD. :thumbsup:
